property_summary: For every owner-supplied fee withdrawal, any previously accrued unclaimedFees balance must either remain unchanged (if the external fee transfer fails/reverts) or be transferred out and zeroed atomically, so unclaimedFees[asset] can only become zero when the corresponding tokens actually left the contract; the bug zeroes unclaimedFees without transferring, so a recorder helper observes no fee token movement.
change_summary: Delete the `ERC20(asset).transfer(recipient, fees);` statement so no external token transfer is performed while the fee balance is cleared.
